name: ballast
description: A Meteora DBC launch class with an on-chain, executable buyback floor.
//packageManager: Pinned explicitly because C:\Users\HP\package.json, above this repo, declares packageManager=yarn. Without this, corepack resolves the wrong manager for every command run here.

scripts.test:property: cross-env PROPTEST_CASES=100000 cargo test -p ballast-floor --test properties
scripts.test:wasm: cargo build -p floor-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && tsx sdk/typescript/test/differential.ts
scripts.proof:devnet: cargo build --release -p ballast-verifier && BALLAST_CLUSTER=devnet tsx scripts/proof/local.ts
